description: Nishat Chunian Limited is a vertically integrated textile company that began in 1990 with a single spinning mill of 14,400 spindles and is now, by its own account, the fifth largest textile company in Pakistan in terms of sales. It spins 85,000 tons of yarn a year across eight mills, weaves greige fabric on 379 air-jet looms, and dyes, prints and stitches finished fabric, with a captive power plant supplying all its units. Its major markets include Hong Kong, mainland China, the Middle East, Bangladesh and Europe.
sourceNote: Written from: nishat.net — home, businesses, spinning, weaving, home textiles, corporate governance and contact us pages (accessed 2026-10-17)

products.name: Spun yarn
products.summary: 85,000 tons a year of greige ring-spun yarn from 225,000 spindles in eight mills, supplied to denim weavers, knitters, towelers, sheeting, shirting, workwear, apparel and upholstery manufacturers.

products.name: Greige and technical fabric
products.summary: 72 million metres a year from 379 air-jet looms in percale, twill, drill, matt, oxford, sateen, herringbone and dobby or jacquard constructions, plus fire-retardant and high-strength industrial fabrics.

products.name: Home textiles — bed linen
products.summary: Dyed, printed and finished sheeting up to 340 cm wide and 1,200 thread count, with integrated stitching of flat and fitted sheets, pillowcases, duvet covers, curtains and table linen.
